title: Abschlusses eines nicht-exkl. Rabattvertrags nach § 130a Absatz 8 bzw. 130c Absatz 1 SGB V für die Zeit vom 01.12.2026 bis zum i.d.R. 30.11.2028
description: Die vorliegende Bekanntmachung dient dem Abschluss von Arzneimittelrabattverträgen gemäß §§ 130 a Abs. 8 bzw. 130c Abs. 1 SGB. Es handelt sich nicht um die Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge im Sinne der Richtlinie 2014/24/EU bzw. der §§ 97 ff GWB. Vertragspartner kann jeder pharmazeutische Unternehmer gemäß § 4 Abs. 18 AMG werden. Gemäß der Rechtsprechung des EuGH unterliegen derartige Zulassungsverfahren nicht zwingend dem Vergaberecht, da aufgrund der fehlenden Auswahlentscheidung kein Wettbewerb stattfindet. Die Bekanntmachung dient als Aufforderung zum Abschluss von Rabattverträgen mit für alle Vertragspartner gleich geltenden und nicht dispositiven Konditionen einschließlich der Festlegung des Rabattes. Der Vertragsschluss erfolgt durch Unterzeichnung der Vertragsunterlagen und Abgabe der geforderten Erklärungen, welche bei der benannten Kontaktstelle angefordert werden können.

title: Gantry Crane
description: The Naval Air Systems Command, Lakehurst, NJ intends to issue a contract on a limited competition basis between B.E Wallace and their authorized distributors for the acquisition of two (2) P/N: M582A2T21-A20 Gantry Cranes. Their purpose is needed in support of the overhead lifting during Remove and Replace (R&R) of the Electro Optical/ Infrared (EO/IR) Turret Deployment Unit in conjunction with P/N: HLU-500/E Hoist. B.E Wallace owns the proprietary rights to the drawing and design of this equipment. As the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), B.E Wallace is the only source with the requisite knowledge, experience, technical expertise and technical data to provide the required PSE. The Government does not own rights to the drawings and technical data package necessary to support a competitive acquisition. There are no other manufacturers identified that were able to meet the Government's requirements. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposal; however, the Government will consider all responses received within 15 days after the date of publication of this synopsis. Information received as a result of this notice of intent will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a full and open competitive requirement. A determination by the Government not to open the requirement to full and open competition based upon responses to this notice in solely within the discretion of the Government. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. No contract will be awarded on the basis of offers received in response to this notice. All inquiries and concerns must be addressed to the Contract Specialist, Ms. Alexis Kelly at alexis.r.kelly.civ@us.navy.mil. Responses to this notice must be submitted by 07 November 2025. A determination not to compete this requirement is within the discretion of the Government. Any response to this notice must be advantageous to the Government in a future competition.

title: Request for Information (RFI) Obtaining Food Franchise Rights in Washington, DC - National Capital Region (NCR)
description: Request for Information (RFI) : Obtaining Food Franchise Rights in Washington, DC - Northern Capital Region (NCR) The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to gather detailed input from qualified organizations regarding the requirements, processes, and opportunities associated with obtaining food franchise rights within the Northern Capital Region (NCR), Washington, DC. Organizations responding to this RFI are requested to provide all relevant documentation, points of contact, marketing materials, and procedural information. This RFI is for planning and informational purposes only and does not obligate the Government to pursue any further action or future solicitation. Direct Engagement Model � Industry Feedback Requested In addition to information on obtaining food franchise rights generally, the FBI is specifically interested in understanding the feasibility and attractiveness of a direct-engagement model, in which the FBI would contract or otherwise arrange directly with individual food franchise brands (rather than through a single master food-service contractor) to provide food service operations within the J. Edgar Hoover Building (JEH), Washington, DC. What the FBI should understand about this model: Typical franchise agreement structures, term lengths, and capital investment requirements (buildout, equipment, branding) when a franchisor/franchisee operates within a federal government-controlled facility rather than a traditional commercial or retail location Licensing, royalty, and territory considerations that may apply or require modification for a single-tenant government building Food safety, supply chain, and operational standards the franchise would need to meet or adapt to operate within a secure federal facility Any precedent for franchise operations within federal buildings, military installations, or other access-controlled environments, and lessons learned from those arrangements All responses must be submitted to: Ms. McKenzie P. Bucher, mpbucher@fbi.gov Mr. Tom Teets, twteets@fbi.gov Please provide all requested information no later than September 21, 2026, at 12:00 PM EDT.

description: FBO ANNOUNCEMENT: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE, NOTICE OF INTENT ACTION CODE: Presolicitation Notice SUBJECT: Sole source � Replacement Cesium Source Head for a Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry Instrument RESPONSE DATE: 11/07/26 DESCRIPTION: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) relies on a time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF-SIMS) instrument. Currently, the Cesium Source Head is non-functional and requires urgent replacement to restore operation. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) intends to negotiate on a sole source basis, under the authority of FAR Part 12.102(b) with ION-TOF USA, Inc located in Chestnut Ridge, New York, for this replacement equipment. Sole Source justification is based on the following: Market research has shown that ION-TOF is the sole source for replacement equipment for this NIST owned Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry Instrument instrument. ION-TOF has stated in writing stated that: �ION-TOF USA, Inc. is the only company authorized and capable of offering service and spare parts for the IONTOF range of surface analysis equipment including the TOF-SIMS IV instruments.� NAICS code for this requirement will be 334516� Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing with a small business size of 1000 employees. No solicitation package will be issued. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotations; however, interested parties who regard themselves as capable of fulfilling these requirements are invited to submit responses to the Government for consideration. Responses received by 1:00AM EST on 11/07/26 will be considered by the Government. description: PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE NOTICE CAREFULLY AS IT CONSTITUTES THE ONLY NOTICE THAT WILL BE ISSUED. This is a combined synopsis and solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6-Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. The Naval Undersea Warfare Center Division, Newport (NUWCDIVNPT) intends to award a purchase order on a sole source basis to American Society for Testing and Materials, doing business as ASTM International, CAGE Code: 81346. Full access to the entire collection of ASTM technical standards is available exclusively through ASTM Compass, a copyrighted product solely owned, licensed, and provided by ASTM International. This subscription to ASTM Compass is a renewal of a previously held annual license, which is essential and frequently utilized by Warfare Center Research Commons users from NUWC Newport and NSWC Carderock. title: KSCVC Agreement Extension
description: NASA/KSC has a requirement for continued operation and expansion of the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex (KSCVC) Public Visitor Program (PVP) to include the creation and operation of a new Astronaut Training Experience (ATX) facility for guests. The KSCVC serves as a critical national asset that reaches more than 1.6 million visitors annually and communicates NASA�s mission to the public. Through its PVP, the KSCVC ignites support for NASA initiatives by engaging the public in NASA�s robust history, dynamic present, and inspirational future. Public demand for the current ATX facility greatly outnumbers current operational capacity and reimagined content is vital to communicate NASA�s mission, maintain public enthusiasm, and reinforce support for major programs. A new public ATX will increase capacity; introduce learners to career technical skills desired by the administration and industry; provide a high-tech environment with labs, workshops and makerspaces; and meet the increasing demand of public visitors nationwide. NASA/KSC intends to extend the current KSCVC agreement with Delaware North Companies Parks and Resorts (DNCPR), pursuant to the authority in 51 U.S.C. 20113(k)(2) and (3), for such time as necessary to complete, commission, and operate a new ATX facility. This extension will enable DNCPR to perform and complete all work associated with the development of the new ATX facility, including concept development, preliminary and final design, construction, commissioning, and operational implementation. Because these activities are expected to extend beyond the expiration date of the current KSCVC agreement, continuity of performance is necessary to ensure successful project execution and operations at a reasonable profit. Transitioning responsibility to a successor concessionaire during the design, construction, or commissioning phases significantly increase performance, schedule, and integration risk, adversely impacting NASA/KSC�s objectives for timely delivery and operation of the new ATX facility. Interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to the primary point of contact listed below no later than 5 p.m. ET on November 7, 2026. Such capabilities and qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct this acquisition on a competitive basis. A decision by the Government not to compete this acquisition on a full and open competition basis, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. The Center Ombudsman can be found at https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf

description: Solvencia técnica o profesional. Los licitadores deberán acreditar la solvencia técnica o profesional mediante lo dispuesto en los artículos 88, 89 y 90 de la LCSP, por los medios siguientes: -Relación de los principales servicios, suministros u obras del mismo tipo o naturaleza al que corresponde el objeto de este contrato, realizados en el curso de los cinco últimos años que incluya importe, fechas y el destinatario público o privado, de los mismos. -Se acreditará mediante certificados de buena ejecución expedidos o visados por el órgano competente, cuando el destinatario sea una entidad del sector público; cuando el destinatario sea un sujeto privado, mediante un certificado expedido por éste mediante una declaración o, a falta de este certificado, del empresario acompañado de los documentos obrantes en poder del mismo que acrediten la realización de la prestación u obra (contratos, facturas, etc.). El requisito mínimo de solvencia será que el importe anual acumulado en el año de mayor ejecución sea igual o superior al 50% del valor estimado del contrato, IVA no incluido. El importe mínimo exigido es 42651,84 euros. Se ha optado por esta opción en base a lo estipulado en el apartado 6º de la Memoria justificativa del contrato, donde los firmantes de la misma entienden que si la empresa licitadora ha ejecutado trabajos de igual o similar naturaleza de la actual licitación por un importe igual o superior al 50% del valor estimado del contrato para cada lote, en uno de los últimos cinco años, va a tener solvencia técnica suficiente para desarrollar el mismo. Entendiendo que la experiencia tiene un efecto directo en la mejora del cumplimiento de los objetivos propuestos en el Proyecto de la obra y en el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas. En caso de uniones temporales de empresarios, a los efectos de solvencia técnica y profesional, se estará a lo regulado en el artículo 69 LCSP. En su caso, deberá aportar el compromiso al que se refiere el artículo 75.2 de la LCSP, relativo a la integración de la solvencia con medios externos. Para las empresas de nueva creación, entendiendo por tal aquella que tenga una antigüedad inferior a 5 años, se estará a lo dispuesto en el artículo 88.2 de la LCSP. Su solvencia técnica se acreditará por los medios a que se refieren las letras b), c), y f) del artículo 88.1

title: Finland – Security services – Vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut
description: Hankinnan kohteena on vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut Kainuun hyvinvointialueella. Palvelun kohteena ovat Tilaajan Toimeksiantosopimuksissa määrittelemät kohteet. Turvallisuuspalvelut sisältävät paikallisvartiointia, kiertävä vartiointi (ent. piirivartiointi), hälytys- ja tilausvartiointia. Vartiointipalveluiden tarkoituksena on ylläpitää ja edistää turvallisuutta sovituilla vartioimisalueilla ja -kohteissa, sekä tarvittaessa ryhtyä lain (Laki yksityisistä turvallisuuspalveluista 1085/2015) sallimissa rajoissa toimenpiteisiin turvallisuuden palauttamiseksi. Vartiointi - ja hälytyskeskuspalvelu koostuu mm. seuraavista palveluista (tarkemmin kuvattu Palvelukuvauksessa (liite 6): -Paikallisvartiointi; siihen liittyvä tilausvartiointi (yksittäinen tehtävä etukäteen tilattu) -Hälytyskäynnit -Kiertävä vartiointi (ent. piirivartiointi) -Hälytyskeskuspalvelu (esim. murtohälytysjärjestelmien testaus/hälytyksen siirrot, hälytysten vastaanottaminen) -Henkilöturvaan, omaisuuteen ja kiinteistöön liittyvät hälytykset Kainuun hyvinvointialueen toimitiloissa ja kiinteistöissä (mm. ovien kiinniolojen seuranta, jääkaappihälytykset, N-kaappien hälytykset, henkilöstön avustaminen pukukaappien avauksessa) -Yleiset kiinteistön pitoon liittyvät aputyöt (esim. puku- ja laukkukaappien avaukset vikatilanteessa, tarvittaessa pukukaappien tarkastukset), Vuototilanteissa huolto/kalustesulkujen sulkeminen (päivystävä huoltomies ohjeistaa), lipunnosto Kainuun keskussairaalassa -Aula- ja paikallisvartiointipalvelut Kainuun keskussairaalassa: (esim. väliaikaisten kulkuoikeuksien ja - lupien hallinta, palohälytyksiin reagointi ja keskussairaalan kuulutukset) Hälytyskeskuspalvelut sisältyvät toimeksiantosopimukseen ilman erillistä korvausta palvelukuvauksen mukaisesti. Hälytyskeskuspalvelun tarkoituksena on jatkuva päivystäminen (24/7 palvelu), joka mahdollistaa erilaisten palvelupyyntöjen vastaanottamisen ja niihin reagoimisen.

title: Finland – Surgical specialist services – Ortopedian erikoislääkäripalvelut
description: Kainuun hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia ortopedian erikoislääkäripalveluista Kainuun hyvinvointialueelle. Palvelua hankitaan vastaanottopalveluna kirurgian poliklinikalle, päivystyspalveluna vapaamuotoisena päivystyksenä viikonloppu- ja arkiviikkopäivystyksenä sekä leikkaussalipalveluna ja tarvittaessa osastotyöskentelynä kirurgisella osastolla. Vastaanottopalvelu käsittää poliklinikkapäiviä (noin 15 potilasta/päivä). Päiväaikaiseen työhön voi tilaajan tarpeiden mukaan sisältyä kirurgisen osaston osastotyö, puhelinkonsultaatiot, ja vastaanottotyö poliklinikalla tai leikkaustoiminta leikkausosastolla. Jos työohjelmassa on pelkästään poliklinikkatyötä, on potilasmäärä n. 15 potilasta enimmillään. Arkiviikkopäivystys (maanantai -torstai) alkaa klo 15.30 ja päättyy klo 8.00 seuraavana päivänä. Päivystyspalvelun vapaamuotoinen päivystys viikonloppupäivystyksenä, jolloin työ alkaa perjantaina klo 15.00 ja päättyy maanantaina klo 8.00 (aktiivityön määrä noin 30 - 50 %). Leikkaussalipalvelussa ortopediset toimenpiteet yhdessä leikkaussalissa klo 7.30 - 16.00. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja kestää 31.12.2028 saakka. Lisäksi tilaaja varaa option yhdelle (1) vuodelle.

description: Per 2026 zijn in de cao Werken voor Waterschappen nieuwe mobiliteitsafspraken opgenomen. Eén van deze afspraken is dat de werkgever de werknemer op diens verzoek een openbaarvervoerkaart ter beschikking kan stellen in ruil voor de bestaande vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. De directie van Waterschap AGV heeft op basis van het directievoorstel mobiliteitsregeling AGV besloten de mobiliteitsregeling in te voeren. Daarbij heeft de directie als uitgangspunten vastgesteld dat de regeling moet bijdragen aan: • duurzamer reisgedrag van medewerkers; • goed werkgeverschap; • het stimuleren van aanwezigheid en ontmoeting op kantoor; • een uitvoerbare en beheersbare inrichting van processen en systemen. Om deze directiekeuze tijdig, rechtmatig en doelmatig te kunnen uitvoeren, is het noodzakelijk een geschikte marktpartij te contracteren voor de levering en uitvoering van de openbaar vervoer voorziening. Het inkooptraject is erop gericht een contractpartij te selecteren die niet alleen de mobiliteitskaart levert, maar ook de bijbehorende dienstverlening kan bieden die nodig is voor implementatie, beheer, rapportage, ondersteuning van gebruikers en een verwerkbare aansluiting op HR-, financiële en salarisprocessen.

title: Netherlands – Sewage services – Raamovereenkomst Reinigen, preventief en correctief onderhoud mechanische installaties SWWB de Baronie 2027-2028
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de hoofdstuk 2 ARW 2016. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Deelnemers zijn naast de Gemeente Breda: Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau, Gemeente Gilze en Rijen, Baarle-Hertog en Gemeente Etten-Leur. Opdracht De opdracht betreft het reinigen en het preventief en correctief onderhouden van de mechanische installaties 2027-2028 binnen de deelnemende gemeenten van het Samenwerkingsverband Waterbeheer West-Brabant (SWWB). Percelen Deze opdracht is verdeeld in de volgende percelen: Perceel 1: ABG-organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de dienstverlening per perceel een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één opdrachtnemer met een looptijd van 2 jaar met als ingangsdatum 1 januari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft het recht deze overeenkomst, met tweemaal met één jaar te verlengen. De opdrachtgever zal minimaal 6 maanden voor het aflopen van het contract, de aannemer schriftelijk op de hoogte stellen of de opdrachtgever van de optie tot verlenging van het contract gebruik zal maken. Anders eindigt het contract automatisch na het bereiken van de einddatum. Minimale termijn van 6 maanden geldt ook voor de optie jaren. Eventuele verlenging geschiedt onder gelijkblijvende condities en voorwaarden. De opdrachtgevers kunnen elk individueel besluiten om al dan niet tot verlenging van de overeenkomst over te gaan zonder dat dit consequenties heeft in welke vorm dan ook voor de overige individuele opdrachtgevers. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op: Perceel 1: ABG- - organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog € 1.700.000,-; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur € 1.100.000,-; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda € 1.200.000-,. bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Q501--STAT CLINICAL LAB TESTING AND AUTOPSIES
description: 15 The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 2, Health Service Area (HSA) 2.1, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6, is conducting market research to determine the availability and capability of qualified businesses to provide comprehensive referral laboratory testing, specimen transportation, and autopsy services for the Central Virginia VA Health Care System, including Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center. The Government is seeking information from Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs), Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (VOSBs), and other Small Business concerns, including 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), and Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) concerns. The anticipated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 621511, Medical Laboratories. The applicable small business size standard is $45.5 million. This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research and acquisition-planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or request for proposal. Submission of a response does not obligate the Government to issue a future solicitation or award a contract. I. GENERAL SCOPE OF SERVICES The contemplated requirement is for a contractor to provide a full range of referral laboratory and autopsy services. The contractor shall be capable of supporting both clinical pathology and anatomic pathology requirements. Required services are anticipated to include, but are not limited to: Performing analytical testing described in the contractor s reference test manual and the Government s attached test list. Receiving, processing, analyzing, and maintaining the integrity of clinical and anatomic pathology specimens. Reporting test results within established turnaround times. Providing routine, urgent, and STAT testing, as applicable. Providing consultative services concerning: Test selection; Specimen collection; Specimen handling and preservation; Transportation requirements; and Interpretation of test results. Providing supplies and materials required for the collection and transportation of specimens, as applicable. Providing secure transportation of specimens from Government-designated collection locations to the testing laboratory. Providing electronic access to test information and patient results. Providing hospital or medical autopsy services, including gross and microscopic examination, final reports, and related professional consultation. Coordinating transportation arrangements associated with autopsy services, if required by the Government. The anticipated service area includes Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center and any associated Central Virginia VA Health Care System locations identified in the resulting solicitation. The final solicitation, if issued, will establish the definitive scope, locations, quantities, schedules, performance standards, and reporting requirements. II. LICENSURE, CERTIFICATION, AND ACCREDITATION Any reference laboratory performing services under the contemplated requirement, including a branch, division, affiliate, or subcontracted laboratory, shall possess all licenses, certifications, accreditations, and inspections required by applicable federal and state laws and regulations. Respondents shall identify their current laboratory accreditations and certifications, which may include: Certification under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA); Accreditation through an accrediting organization with deemed status from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), such as: College of American Pathologists (CAP); COLA; or The Joint Commission; Applicable Nuclear Regulatory Commission licenses; Applicable federal and state laboratory licenses or certifications; and Any other certification or accreditation required for the proposed testing or autopsy services. The contractor shall comply with applicable requirements governing the privacy and security of protected health information, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act and its implementing regulations. Respondents shall identify the accreditation and certification status of every location that may perform testing or autopsy services, including proposed subcontractors and third-party reference laboratories. III. SPECIMEN TRANSPORTATION AND STAT TESTING Respondents shall describe their ability to provide secure and timely transportation of clinical and anatomic pathology specimens from Government-designated collection locations. As well as the capability to provide hospital or medical autopsy services, including: IV. CAPABILITY-STATEMENT REQUIREMENTS Interested parties shall submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to satisfy the contemplated requirement. Responses should include: Legal name and address of the firm. Unique Entity Identifier. Point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Business size and socioeconomic status under NAICS code 621511, including, as applicable: SDVOSB; VOSB; 8(a); HUBZone; WOSB; EDWOSB; or Other Small Business. Confirmation of the firm s current SAM.gov registration status. Confirmation that any claimed veteran-owned status is verified in the applicable Small Business Administration veteran-certification system. A detailed capability statement addressing the laboratory testing, transportation, STAT testing, and autopsy requirements described in this notice. The number of years the firm has provided comparable laboratory or autopsy services. Relevant experience providing similar services to federal agencies, VA medical facilities, hospitals, or other healthcare systems. Current licenses, certifications, and accreditations. Identification of the location or locations where testing and autopsy services would be performed. A description of the firm s courier and specimen-transportation network. A description of the firm s electronic ordering and result-reporting capabilities. Identification of any proposed subcontractors, affiliates, branches, or third-party reference laboratories and the services each would perform. A description of how the respondent would perform the requirement while complying with FAR 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting, if applicable. Identification of any services the respondent cannot provide. Any recommendations concerning contract structure, performance period, test-list organization, pricing method, or other matters that may improve competition or performance. Respondents should clearly distinguish between services performed by the prime contractor and services performed by subcontractors or third-party laboratories. V. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Capability statements should not exceed five pages, excluding the cover page and copies of licenses, certifications, or accreditations. Responses shall be submitted electronically no later than: October 27, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. ET Submit responses by email to: Gordon Burns Network Contracting Office 6 VA Medical Center 27 Averill Avenue Hampton, VA 23667 Email: gordon.burns@va.gov The email subject line shall state: 36C24627Q0079 Autopsies and Lab Testing This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market research and acquisition-planning purposes only. It is not a solicitation, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or request for proposal. The Government is not requesting pricing or formal offers at this time. Responses will assist the Government in determining the availability and capability of qualified businesses and in developing an appropriate acquisition strategy. title: SITA Services to Electronically Transmit Airline Data
description: This is a NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT under the authority of FAR 13.501. U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) intends to solicit and negotiate directly with SITA Information Networking Computing USA Inc. (SITA) for services to electronically transmit airline data to CBP. The CBP Office of Information and Technology (OIT) Enterprise Data Management and Engineering Directorate (EDMED) has a continuing requirement to electronically obtain Passenger Name Records (PNR), air cargo manifests, and other airline-related data and messaging in support of CBP's mission, and statutory and regulatory requirements, to screen people and cargo entering and exiting the United States. CBP intends to award a contract without considering other awardees pursuant to RFO 16.507-6. A large number of commercial air carriers currently interface with DHS to provide the required information and many of these DHS carrier partners have exclusive commercial agreements with SITA to utilize SITA�s network to provide information to DHS. SITA�s services include an extensive multi-national carrier industry network and communications solutions which enable both our carrier industry partners and DHS to securely transmit data and support DHS�s anti-terrorism mission as required. Air carriers have commercial agreements with SITA to securely transmit passenger and cargo information and provide DHS with two-way communication, as required, via SITA�s approved interface and the usage of SITA�s proprietary software (Runway). Failure to continue the current SITA support services would disavow those carriers currently serviced by SITA preventing them from being able to comply with US government mandates. This is a firm-fixed price (FFP) Contract for services. A FFP type will provide maximum incentive for the contractor to control costs and perform effectively and impose a minimum administrative burden upon the contracting parties, reducing technical, schedule, and cost risk to the Government. The Government determined the work described in the Statement of Work (SOW) is definitive enough where it can be priced with a reasonable degree of confidence; therefore, FFP was selected as the appropriate contract type.

title: eCMS 2nd Bridge
description: The required services encompass the highly specialized technical, operational, database, and security administration support necessary to sustain the legacy CMiC eCMS application, while simultaneously executing the technical migration of historical project data to the follow-on Kahua system. Continuous operation of this application is vital to the NAVFAC enterprise mission, as it enables quality control workflows between thousands of external construction contractors, Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs), Construction Quality Management (CQM) personnel, and Project Managers. While the follow-on eCMS 2.0 contract (N39430-25-C-0010) was successfully competed and awarded to Procon Consulting LLC (Procon) in August 2025, two major, unforeseen external factors stalled the planned transition schedule: 1. A 43-day partial federal government shutdown at the start of Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26). 2. Complex, multi-agency coordination required to obtain the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Provisional Authorization (PA) for the new Kahua Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environment. These disruptions created an execution gap that halted database migration tasks requiring proprietary database schema coordination between Bahfed and Procon. A one-year sole-source extension of Bahfed's services is required to bridge this execution gap, maintain the secure cloud hosting environment, deploy security hotfixes, and finalize the structured data transfer to the new competitive platform. The estimated value of this 12-month extension is $3,500,000, based on the Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE). The requirement will be funded using Operations & Maintenance, Navy (O&M,N) appropriations.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – Montagebau in Holz
description: Der geplante Neubau des Primarschulhauses Allmend verfolgt das Ziel, eine zukunftsfähige, nachhaltige und pädagogisch funktionale Infrastruktur für die Primarstufe 1 bis 6 zu schaffen. Der viergeschossige Baukörper wird in konventioneller Holzbauweise auf dem Schulareal errichtet und ersetzt dort die bestehende Aussensportanlage („Roter Platz“). Die geologischen und hydrogeologischen Rahmenbedingungen auf dem Areal gelten als anspruchsvoll. Es sind insbesondere zwei voneinander zu trennende Grundwasserstockwerke zu berücksichtigen. Der Baugrund verlangt eine Pfahlgründung (Betonverdrängungsbohrpfähle), auch für Werkleitungen und Kontrollschächte (Holzpfähle). Im Hinblick auf den Hochwasserschutz erfüllt der Neubau die Anforderungen HQ300- Die Haustechnik wird im Erdgeschoss und obersten Geschoss platziert (kein UG), um Schäden durch Hochwasserereignisse zu vermeiden. Die Tragstruktur des Gebäudes basiert auf einem Massivholzskelett aus Fi/Ta. Ergänzt wird dieses durch drei massive Servicekerne aus Stahlbeton. Die Wendeltreppen zwischen den Servicekernen sind ebenfalls in Stahlbeton ausgeführt. Die Fassade besteht aus vorgefertigten Holzständer-Aussenelementen. Das Gebäude wird nach SNBS 2.1 Hochbau zertiﬁziert (Ziel ist Gold Zertiﬁzierung). Die Energieversorgung erfolgt über einen Anschluss an das lokale Fernwärmenetz SeeEnergy (Winter Wärme, Sommer Kühlwasser). Alle Flächen werden mit Fussbodenheizung ausgelegt. Alle Bodenbeläge sind aus geschliffenem industriellem Beton und dienen als Speichermasse und leichtes Free-Cooling hinsichtlich sommerlicher Überhitzungsstunden. Die Regelung erfolgt über Raumtemperaturfühler und ist Nutzern abhängig. Zur Stromgewinnung wird eine gebäudeintegrierte Photovoltaikanlage auf dem Dach als wasserführende Gebäudehülle installiert. Brise-Soleil-konstruktion aus Metall entlang den Fassaden Ost und West dienen als Schattenwerfer und bilden den konstruktiven Witterungsschutz der Fassade. Im Bereich der Gebäudetechnik wird auf nur in den Bereichen der innenliegenden Kerne und der Aula den Einbau einer mechanischen Lüftungsanlage vorgesehen. Die Klassenzimmer erhalten Frischluft über eine manuelle natürliche Fensterlüftung. Das Gebäude ist vollständig hindernisfrei nutzbar. Für das geplante Schulgebäude mit einer Gesamthöhe von ca. 19 m in Hybridbauweise gilt als Gebäude mittlerer Höhe. Die brandschutztechnische Planung erfolgt gemäss Qualitätsstufe QSS 2 der BS-Richtlinie der VKF. Die Umgebungsgestaltung orientiert sich am Gestaltungskonzept „Zentrum 1. + 2. Etappe“ und trägt zur Entwicklung eines einheitlichen öffentlichen Freiraums im Zentrum Horw bei. Der Schulhaus-Pausenplatz wird als verkehrsfreier, öffentlich zugänglicher Raum ausgestaltet, mit Rücksicht auf die ausserschulische Mitbenutzung. Der Schulhausgarten dient ausschliesslich der schulischen Nutzung und ist entsprechend kindgerecht und naturnah gestaltet. Im Sinne der Klimaanpassung und Biodiversitätsförderung werden.

title: Bulgaria – Construction work – Ремонт фасади и помещения на КАС и ЗРУ в п/ст Златоград
description: Електрическа подстанция (п/ст) „Златоград“ е разположена в поземлен имот с идентификатор 31111.31.552, съгласно Кадастрална карта и кадастрални регистри на област Смолян, община Златоград, гр. Златоград. Подстанцията се експлоатира от ЕСО ЕАД, управления „Мрежови експлоатационен район Пловдив“ (УМЕР Пловдив), отдел Смолян. Достъпът до подстанцията се осъществява по асфалтов път, част от общинската пътна мрежа на града. Не съществуват ограничения за придвижване на стандартна механизация. Географските координати на п/ст „Златоград“ са: 41°23'18" N и 25°05'11"Е. Предмет на настоящата поръчка е изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи (СМР) по командно-технологичните сгради (КАС и ЗРУ 20 kV), както следва: 1.Сграда за ЗРУ Възстановяване на антикорозионната защита на покривното покритие чрез полагане на антикорозионен грунд и крайно покритие на алкидна основа – боя за метал сребърен феролит; Подмяна на вертикалните отводнители от покривното отводняване; Подмяна на металните врати на северната фасада с пожароустойчиви двукрили плътни врати, клас на огнеустойчивост EI 90; Подмяна на металната дограма на сградата за ЗРУ 20 kV с нова дограма от алуминиев профил с прекъснат термомост, в т.ч съпътстващите ремонта довършителни дейности – обръщане на страници, полагане на крайно покритие и други; Полагане на шпакловка в два пласта с лепило за топлоизолация и силикатна мазилка по фасади. Полагане на грунд и полимерна мозаична мазилка по цокъл със средна височина 60cm и по страници на тераси; Възстановяване на компрометираните участъци от вътрешна мазилка/шпакловка на първи и втори етаж. Цялостно грундиране с импрегниращ грунд за уеднаквяване попивната повърхност по стените, боядисване с латекс по стени; Възстановяване на антикорозионната защита на метални парапети и евакуационни стълби. 2. Командно-административна сграда Подмяна на вертикално покривно отводняване; Възстановяване на компрометираните участъци от външна мазилка. Полагане на грунд и фасадна боя (фасаген) по фасади. Полагане на грунд и полимерна мозаична мазилка по цокъл със средна височина 60 cm; Възстановяване на повърхността и бояджийското покритие по декоративни дървени елементи и обшивки по тераси и стрехи. Подмяна на компрометирани дървени елементи по източни тераси; Подмяна на дървена и метална дограма (врати и прозорци) в избени помещения с алуминиева. Подмяна на метална входна врата за сградата. Подмяна на дървена врата в санитарно помещение на втори етаж. Предвиждат се съществуващите вътрешни метални врати между КАС и ЗРУ 20 kV да се демонтират и да се заменят с пожароустойчиви, плътни врати с клас на огнеустойчивост EI 90; Очукване на компрометирана мазилка/шпакловка в помещенията, частично шпакловане на стени и тавани и боядисване с латекс; В командна зала – подмяна на теракота, очукване на компрометирана шпакловка/мазилка, шпакловка по таван, грундиране и боядисване с латекс; Боядисване на стени, парапети и ръкохватки в стълбищна клетка на сутеренен етаж. ​​​​​​​3. Външна ограда на КАС Демонтаж, доставка и монтаж на масивна дървена пешеходна врата; Възстановяване на повърхността и бояджийското покритие по декоративни дървени елементи по ограда от каменна зидария и навес над входна врата. Добитите строителни отпадъци по време на изпълнение на строителните и монтажните дейности се събират разделно, съгласно изискванията на Наредба № 2/23.07.2014 г. за класификацията на строителните отпадъци и се извозват регулярно до регламентирано сметище.

description: Kytökankaantie jatke rakennusurakka Kytökankaantien jatkeen rakentaminen 2026 Nivalan kaupungin teknisen osaston tekniset palvelut-yksikkö pyytää avoimella tarjousmenettelyllä tarjoustanne oheisen luettelon mukaisista maa-aineksista ja maarakennustöistä yksikköhintaurakkana. Tarjouspyyntö koskee Nivalan taajamaan rakennettavan Kytökankaantien jatkeen rakentamista, yhteensä tien pituus noin 450 metriä. Rakennusurakka koskee kadun ja erillisen kevyenliikenteen rakentamista rinnakkain. Tarkka pituus sovitaan sopimuksessa. Tähän tarjoukseen ei saa sisällyttää muita ehtoja kuin, mitä tässä tarjouspyynnössä ja tarjouspyynnön liiteasiakirjoissa on esitetty. Vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Tilaaja pidättää oikeuden hylätä kaikki tarjoukset. Nivalan kaupungin taajamassa olevan Kytökankaantien jatkeen rakennusurakka sisältäen maa-ainekset, maarakennustyöt, sadevesi- ja salaoja putkitusten asentaminen ja tehtävän työn suunnittelun sekä työnjohdon liitteenä olevien suunnitelmien mukaan. Kohteesta on laadittu koneenohjaussuunnitelmia valmiiksi. Urakoitsijan tulee käyttää koneenohjausmallia ja mitata tehdystä työstä sopimuksen mukaiset tarkepisteet. Tarkemittaus tarkkuus sovitaan sopimusvaiheessa yleisten normien mukaisesti. Lisäksi dwg-muotoiset suunnitelmat ovat käytettävissä. Kyseessä on uusien katujen rakentaminen kaava-alueelle. Urakan päätoteuttajana toimii pääurakoitsija. Päätoteuttaja vastaa rakennustyömaan yleisjohdosta, työmaan turvallisuusjohtamisesta eri urakoitsijoiden töiden yhteensovittamisesta sekä muista lainsäädännössä päätoteuttajalle määrätyistä velvoitteista. Tarjous annetaan tarjousasiakirjojen osana olevalle lomakkeelle. Lomakkeen voi täyttää joko pdf- tai excel- taulukkona. Lomaketta ei saa muuttaa. Tarkempi kuvaus löytyy liitteestä: Tarjouspyyntö Kytökankaantie jatke,

title: Indoor Firing Range Cleaning
description: The 115th Fighter Wing in Madison WI is conducting market research to identify sources capable of providing indoor firing range cleaning in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). The Government intends to use information received in response to this Sources Sought notice to: assess industry capability and commercial availability; identify customary commercial practices for indoor firing range cleaning; identify potential issues, ambiguities, omissions, or recommended revisions to the PWS; and evaluate the feasibility of a small-business or other socioeconomic set-aside acquisition strategy. This notice is issued solely for market-research and planning purposes. It is not a solicitation, request for proposal, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing or submitting a response. Range Ammunition History: The range does not currently use, and has not used, lead ammunition. Respondents are requested to consider this condition when reviewing the PWS and providing recommended commercial practices, required safety measures, cleaning methods, waste-handling procedures, and proposed PWS revisions. Responses should provide company information, which must include: Business name. Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). Provide a brief description of experience and capability to perform services as described in the PWS. Include if these services can be self-performed or if they will be subcontracted. The respondent�s business size under the recommended NAICS code and applicable size standard ($12.5M for 811310), along with any applicable socioeconomic designations Respondents are requested to review the attached PWS and provide feedback on the following items. Responses may be used to refine the requirement and revise the PWS. State whether the PWS can be performed as written. If not, identify the specific requirement at issue and provide a recommended revision or alternative approach. Identify any requirement that is unclear, ambiguous, incomplete, impractical, unusually restrictive, inconsistent with customary commercial practice, or likely to create unnecessary cost, schedule, safety, or performance risk. The range does not currently use, and has not historically used, lead ammunition. Based on this condition, identify any PWS requirements that should be revised, removed, added, or tailored. Explain the basis for each recommendation. Identify any cleaning, inspection, preventive-maintenance, testing, documentation, reporting, consumable, or support service that is normally included in a commercial turnkey indoor firing range cleaning and maintenance service but is not addressed in the PWS. Identify any additional information that would be needed to accurately price and perform the requirement, Identify qualifications, licenses, certifications, OEM authorizations, or specialized personnel required for the work. Any other recommendations or concerns. The Government is considering conducting a pre-solicitation site visit for interested vendors. The purpose of a site visit would be to allow potential offerors to observe facility conditions and obtain information relevant to the anticipated requirement. Interested firms should indicate whether they would participate in a pre-solicitation site visit.

title: R425--Temporary Operations and Maintenance Staffing Services for Skilled Trades Louisville VA Medical Center, Kentucky
description: Title:� Temporary Operations and Maintenance Staffing Services for Skilled Trades Louisville VA Medical Center, Kentucky Agency:� Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Place of Performance: New Louisville VA Medical Center, 4906 Brownsboro Road, Louisville, KY 40222 Robley Rex VA Medical Center, 800 Zorn Avenue, Louisville, KY 40206-1433 Other VA locations within the Louisville VAMC catchment area, as required Description The Department of Veterans Affairs is conducting market research to identify capable and qualified businesses that can provide temporary operations and maintenance staffing services for the Louisville VA Medical Center during facility activation, commissioning, and ongoing operations. The anticipated requirement supports patient care, life-safety systems, and mission-essential healthcare infrastructure. The contractor would recruit, screen, employ, supervise, and provide qualified personnel to perform facility operations, maintenance, repair, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, commissioning support, and related work.� Contractor personnel will not perform inherently governmental functions. The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month base period with up to two 1-year option periods.� This notice is issued solely for market-research and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation, request for proposal, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. Anticipated Labor Categories and Estimated Staffing The Government anticipates a need for the following labor categories. Quantities are estimates only and do not guarantee a minimum level of effort. Labor Category Estimated FTEs Utility Systems Repairer-Operator (USRO) 8 Maintenance Mechanic (Multi-Trade) 4 Pipefitter / Plumber 3 HVAC Mechanic 4 Scope Highlights Potential contractors must be able to provide personnel qualified to support commercial, institutional, industrial, or healthcare facility systems.� Services may include preventive and corrective maintenance, utility plant operations, HVAC and refrigeration work, plumbing and pipefitting, general multi-trade maintenance, emergency response, and documentation of completed work in the Government s computerized maintenance management system. Key requirements include: Staffing personnel capable of supporting weekdays, evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, rotating shifts, emergency call-back, and, for USRO personnel, continuous 24-hour/7-day coverage as assigned. Providing qualified candidates for routine staffing requirements within 10 business days and, when commercially reasonable, critical vacancies within 5 business days. Replacing personnel within 10 business days unless otherwise approved; immediate removal may be required for safety, security, conduct, or performance reasons. Providing all essential trade tools, testing equipment, uniforms, personal protective equipment, supervision, training, and labor-related costs within fully burdened labor rates. Complying with applicable Federal, VA, OSHA, NFPA, infection-control, life-safety, Lockout/Tagout, and facility-specific requirements. Minimum Personnel Qualifications All proposed personnel must have relevant trade experience, qualifications, licenses, certifications, and demonstrated competency for the assigned labor category.� Personnel must be able to communicate effectively in English; possess a valid REAL ID-compliant identification; complete VA background investigation requirements; obtain and maintain a Personal Identity Verification badge; and meet applicable VA occupational-health requirements. Additional representative qualifications include: USRO:� At least 3 years of utility plant operations and maintenance experience, including systems such as boilers, chilled water plants, cooling towers, pumps, heat exchangers, domestic water, compressed air, and related controls.� Healthcare experience is preferred. HVAC Mechanic:� EPA Section 608 Universal Certification and at least 3 years of commercial, industrial, institutional, or healthcare HVAC experience.� Experience with AHUs, VAV systems, chillers, cooling towers, BAS/DDC controls, and refrigeration systems is required. Pipefitter/Plumber:� At least 3 years of relevant experience and journeyman-level pipefitting, plumbing, or mechanical-piping experience.� Experience with domestic water, sanitary systems, steam, condensate, chilled water, heating hot water, and gas piping is required. Maintenance Mechanic (Multi-Trade):� At least 3 years of commercial, industrial, institutional, or healthcare maintenance experience and journeyman-level experience in building, industrial, or mechanical maintenance.� Medical gas maintenance certification is preferred when medical-gas work is assigned. Security, Training, and Compliance Before assignment, contractor personnel will be subject to Government review and approval and must complete required documentation, background investigation and credentialing actions, VA New Employee Orientation, safety and infection-control training, and other required training.� The contractor must maintain a drug-free workplace and ensure compliance with VA privacy, information-security, records-management, and occupational-health requirements. Requested Capability Statement Interested parties should submit a capability statement that addresses the firm s ability to perform this requirement. Include: Business identification:� Company name, UEI, CAGE code, business address, website, and primary point of contact. Socioeconomic status:� Identify all applicable SBA socioeconomic designations, including small business, SDVOSB, VOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB/EDWOSB, and small disadvantaged business status. Relevant experience:� Describe recent and relevant contracts providing temporary skilled-trades staffing or operations and maintenance support for healthcare, institutional, industrial, or similarly critical facilities.� Include customer, contract number, period of performance, scope, labor categories, staffing levels, and contract value. Recruiting and retention capacity:� Describe the ability to recruit, screen, credential, onboard, and retain qualified USROs, HVAC mechanics, pipefitters/plumbers, and multi-trade maintenance mechanics in the Louisville, Kentucky labor market. Response and replacement capability:� Explain the firm s ability to meet the anticipated candidate-submission and personnel-replacement timeframes. Compliance approach:� Summarize processes for credential verification, licensing and certification tracking, background investigations, PIV credentialing, occupational-health compliance, training, PPE and tool management, electronic timekeeping, and monthly compliance reporting. Pricing information:� Provide nonbinding, fully burdened hourly labor-rate ranges for each anticipated labor category. Rates should account for wages, fringe benefits, taxes, insurance, overhead, profit, supervision, tools, PPE, training, overtime, holiday pay, shift differentials, and other labor-related costs. Contracting approach:� Identify whether the firm would perform as a prime contractor, use subcontractors, or both. If subcontractors are anticipated, identify their roles and relevant capabilities. title: Technology Licensing Opportunity: Electrochemical Recycling Technology for Sustainable Recovery of Tellerium and Cadmium from CdTE Photovoltaics
description: Electrochemical Recycling Technology for Sustainable Recovery of Tellurium and Cadmium from CdTe Photovoltaics In-situ oxidant generation reduces chemical use and environmental impact in solar module recycling Technology Summary This technology enables electrochemical extraction and recovery of tellurium (Te) and cadmium (Cd) from end-of-life and manufacturing scrap cadmium telluride (CdTe) photovoltaic cells. Unlike current recycling methods that rely on externally supplied hydrogen peroxide (H?O?) in acid leaching, this process generates oxidants in situ from oxygen or air using electrochemical methods. The approach decreases reliance on bulk chemicals and significantly lowers the carbon footprint of recycling operations, while still producing Te metal and Cd suitable for reuse in photovoltaic manufacturing. Problem Addressed High environmental footprint of current CdTe PV recycling due to reliance on H?O? production and use. Supply chain and logistics burden from transporting and storing bulk chemicals. Growing need for sustainable recycling as CdTe photovoltaics expand in deployment. Solution Electrochemical in-situ generation of oxidants eliminates external H?O? sourcing. Direct recovery of Te metal and Cd for reintegration into module production. Electricity-driven process supports integration with renewable or nuclear power, lowering lifecycle emissions. Key Advantages Reduced environmental impact: Avoids carbon-intensive bulk chemical manufacturing. Lower logistical burden: Minimizes transportation and storage of hazardous oxidants. Clean energy compatible: Process can run on renewable or low-carbon electricity. Next-generation mining model: Enables sustainable materials recovery aligned with circular economy goals. Market Applications CdTe photovoltaic recycling: Direct application to commercial operations, such as First Solar�s module recovery. Sustainable metals recovery: Broader potential for hydrometallurgical extraction of critical elements. Circular economy strategies: Supports renewable energy companies seeking closed-loop manufacturing.

description: The Commander Fleet Readiness Centers (COMFRC) Procurement Group, Patuxent River, MD 20670 hereby gives notice of their intent to award a purchase order to Laboratory Testing LLC, DBA Assured Testing Services[R(1] , 388 Servidea Dr. Ridgway, PA (CAGE: 25WT7) on a sole source basis in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.102(a), only one source reasonably available and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. title: Arkkitehtisuunnittelu, puitesopimuskilpailutus 2027-2028 ja optiot vuosille 2029 ja 2030
description: Jyväskylän kaupunki (Tilapalvelu liikelaitos ja kaikki toimialat), Jyväskylän Ammattikorkeakoulu Oy (JAMK), Kiinteistö Oy Tikkakosken Terveysasema, Kiinteistö Oy Jyväskylän Lääkäritalo muodostavat hankintarenkaan ja kilpailuttavat pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun puitejärjestelyn tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti ajalle 2027 ja 2028 sekä optiot vuosille 2029 ja 2030. Tarjouspyynnössä on kaksi osa-aluetta, joista laaditaan omat sopimuksensa. Tarjoaja voi tarjota molempia osa-alueita tai yhtä osa-aluetta. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen molempiin osa-alueisiin, mutta voi tulla valituksi vain toiseen. Jos tarjoaja tulee valituksi molempiin osa-alueisiin, sillä on oikeus valita, kumpaan osa-alueeseen se osallistuu. Osa-alueet ovat tarkemmin kuvattu tarjouspyynnöllä. Kyseessä on 8 palveluntuottajan puitejärjestely pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelusta. Osa-alueeseen 1 valitaan neljä (4) palveluntuottajaa. Osa-alueeseen 2 valitaan neljä (4) palveluntuottajaa. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo sopimuskaudelle on yhteensä 2 500 0000 euroa. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo sopimuskaudelle on yhteensä 2 700 000 euroa. Enimmäisarvo sisältä varauksen sopimuskauden aikana ennakolta vaikeasti arvioitaviin hankintatarpeisiin, joiden laajuutta ei voida hankintaa käynnistettäessä luotettavasti arvioida. Enimmäisarvo ei kuvaa hankintayksikön sitoutumista hankintamäärään, vaan hankinnan suurinta mahdollista arvoa sopimuskaudella. Jos enimmäisarvo on saavutettu ennen määräaikaisen sopimuksen tai mahdollisesti käyttöön otetun optiokauden päättymisaikaa, puitejärjestely päättyy. Toimittajalla ei tällöin ole mitään vaatimuksia Tilaajaa kohtaan. Hankinnasta on järjestetty markkinavuoropuhelu 14.8.2026-6.9.2026., OSA-ALUE 1: Investointihankkeet Osa-alue 1 sisältää investointihankkeiden uudisrakennusten ja peruskorjausten rakennussuunnittelun, viitesuunnitelmat, hankesuunnitelmat ja tontinkäyttösuunnitelmat. Suunnittelutehtävissä painottuu koulu- ja päiväkotirakennusten pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelutehtävät. Hankinnat tehdään puitesopimuksen luvun 4. Puitejärjestely mukaisesti., OSA-ALUE 2: Kunnossapito Kunnossapidon pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun tehtäviin kuuluu enintään 60 000 euron työt, joihin sisältyvät vuosikorjausten ja pienten perusparannusten sekä muiden vastaavien pienten korjausten suunnittelutyöt. Suunnittelutöissä korostuvat yleensä nopea reagointi sekä suunnittelijan mahdollisuus saapua työmaalle tai kiinteistölle lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Enintään 60 000 euron arvoiset hankinnat tehdään puitesopimuksen luvun 4. Puitejärjestely mukaisesti.,

title: Finland – Sludge disposal services – Jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettaminen
description: Hankinta koskee jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettamista Metsäsairila Oy:n alueella (Kiertotaloudenkatu 18, 50800 Mikkeli) toimivan yhtiön omistaman biojalostamon varastosäiliöstä. Mädätteen noutoon tarvitaan imuauto, joka päästöluokituksiltaan täyttää Euro VI -kriteerit. Tarjousasiakirjaan on ladattava vapaamuotoinen tiedosto, josta ilmenevät perustiedot palvelun tuottamiseen käytettävästä kalustosta (merkki, vm, euroluokitus, säiliön tilavuus, akselien lkm, päästöt). Mädäte on orgaanista maanparannusainetta, joka täyttää Ruokaviraston sille lannoitekäyttöön asettamat vaatimukset. Mädätettä ei ole separoitu ja sen kuiva-ainepitoisuus on noin 11,5 %. Mädätteen tuotanto on jatkuvaa ja sitä syntyy noin 3 800 - 5 500 tonnia vuodessa. Tuorein, vuoden 2025 lopun näytteistä koostettu tuoteseloste on lisätty tämän tietopyynnön liiteasiakirjaksi. Tuoreempaa tuoteselostetta ei ole, koska reaktori on ollut huoltotoimien vuoksi poissa tuotantokäytöstä kuluneen kesän ajan. Mädätettä syntyy jatkuvasti, joten sen noutokin on jatkuvatoimista. Mädätteen poiskuljetus tapahtuu tilauksesta, josta palvelun tarjoajalla on 1 viikko aikaa noutaa tuote varastosäiliöstä. Varastosäiliö, jonka vetoisuus on noin 750 t mädätettä, ajetaan tyhjäksi yhdellä kertaa tai toimitaan muulla, yhteisesti sovitulla toimintatavalla. Palvelun tuottajan tulee täyttää kaikki tarjouspyyntöön liittyvät ja mädätteen noudosta aiheutuvat kustannukset. Vastuu tuotteesta ja sen hallinta siirtyvät palvelun tuottajalle, kun se on siirretty varastosäiliöstä imuautoon. Palvelu on oltava tarjolla heti sopimuskauden alkaessa.
